photos.title: The MarshWalk from above
photos.what: The MarshWalk from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): Restaurant buildings and decks line a boardwalk along the inlet; Business 17 runs behind them; marsh islands and the tidal creek fill the right side; a marina with boats and a long pier are at the bottom. The MarshWalk dot is OpenStreetMap way 930398329.
photos.caption: The MarshWalk from above: restaurants along the boardwalk at the edge of the inlet, Business 17 behind them, and salt marsh islands in the creek.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the MarshWalk in Murrells Inlet, labelled: restaurant buildings and decks along a boardwalk at the edge of the inlet, Business 17 behind them, marsh islands in the creek and a marina with boats at the bottom

photos.title: Streets of houses between the US 17 bypass and Business 17 from above
photos.what: Streets of houses between the US 17 bypass and Business 17 from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): The four-lane US 17 bypass at the left with a gas station, shops and parking lots along it; Business 17 at the right; between them streets of houses under trees, a loop street of newer houses in the middle, and a road crossing from the bypass toward Business 17; a large building with an orange roof at the bottom. Re-cut on 2026-11-03 so the frame is centred on the houses, not the work buildings to the south.
photos.caption: Between the US 17 bypass and Business 17 from above: streets of houses, with a loop street of newer houses in the middle and shops along the bypass at the left.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of Murrells Inlet, labelled: the US 17 bypass at the left with shops along it, Business 17 at the right, and streets of houses between them, with a loop street of newer houses in the middle

place.sublocation: Between the US 17 bypass and US 17 Business, Georgetown County

photos.title: Creek-front houses with docks from above

photos.caption: Houses on the creek side of Business 17 from above, with docks reaching out over the marsh edge to the creek.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of creek-front houses in Murrells Inlet, labelled: Business 17 at the left, houses under live oaks, and wooden docks running from the yards out to the tidal creek, with salt marsh islands beyond

photos.title: Sunnyside, Murrells Inlet Historic District
photos.what: A white one-and-a-half-story weatherboarded cottage with a front gable, a porch on four square columns, two central brick chimneys and live oaks around it: Sunnyside, in the Murrells Inlet Historic District.
photos.caption: Sunnyside, built about 1850, one of the two planters' houses the creek-side village grew from.
photos.alt: Sunnyside in Murrells Inlet: a white one-and-a-half-story cottage with a front gable, a porch on four square columns, two brick chimneys and a red door, with live oaks around a lawn
